blocks.text: SZTPSLS Windows Tablet with Keyboard 11.6", Detachable 2 in 1 Laptop Touchscreen Windows 11, 6GB RAM 256GB Storage, Intel Celeron , 2.4G+5G WiFi, Bluetooth, USB3.0, HDMI, Dual Camera

items: 🍀 【𝟲𝗚𝗕 𝗥𝗔𝗠 + 𝟭𝟮𝟴 𝗚𝗕 𝗥𝗢𝗠】The 11.6-inch tablet has 6GB RAM, 128GB internal memory. These configurations allow the tablet to have a high response speed and a good working experience. This SZTPSLS tablet is a perfect companion for simultaneous playlist playback, online classes, virtual learning, video conferencing and office work.

🌟 【11.6 inch tablet】 SZTPSLS uses the latest Windows 11 operating system, the Windows tablet offers a user-friendly interface, improved security features, and access to a vast ecosystem of apps and services. Enjoy an up-to-date and uninterrupted experience.

🌈 [2.4/5 𝟱𝗚 𝗪𝗶𝗙𝗶 + 𝗕𝗧 5.0] SZTPSLS Tablet Adapts Windows to an 11.6-inch 𝗜𝗣𝗦 𝗛𝗗 screen 1280 x 800 The tablet is equipped with 5&2.4 𝗯𝗮𝗻𝗱 𝗪𝗜𝗙𝗜 ,𝗕𝗹𝘂𝗲𝘁𝗼𝗼𝘁𝗵 5.0" ensures faster data transfer speeds The tablet on offer is equipped with a clear 5 MP front camera and an 8 MP rear camera, to record every moment of your life.

💎 【2 𝟮 𝗶𝗻 𝟭 𝗹𝗮𝗽𝘁𝗼𝗽 Removable】The 2 𝗶𝗻 𝟭 Removable touchscreen laptop combines the utility of a laptop with the convenience of a tablet. You can remove the keyboard portion of the tablet if you want maximum mobility. The laptop adopts the layout of the KEYBOARD 𝗤𝗪𝗘𝗥𝗧𝗬.
🎁 【Warranty】SZTPSLS 11.6 inch tablet is backed by a 2-year warranty (technical problems caused by non-human or external factors).
